column2: Groundhog Day - February 2nd, 1946

Commander, the Groundhog saw his shadow so we've got a long winter ahead. Now that Finland is free we need to consolidate our front and relieve Lithuania. The Russians have been knocked off balance so I don't expect this to be too much of a problem. General Patton is cleaning out the Balkans as we speak.
Nice Job Commander. Now that our front is consolidated we can prepare for the spring offensive.
Mopping up - March 7th, 1946

Commander, this will be your last assignment before our spring offensive. There is a small pocket of Russian units just north of your current position. We need you to clean them out before they become a more serious problem.

As you know Commander, we have been utilizing a small number of German Nationalist troops as "advisors" in this campaign. The politians have even allowed Germany to produce war materials again. A small German unit will be joining you on this operation. They will also be testing a new tank design. Good luck.
Well, that turned out to be rather nasty didn't it. Yu did very well though and finished up before schedule.
I understand that the German Nationalist troops performed very well. The new tank was a great success.
Now on to our spring offensive.

Comrade General we have to surprise the Germans by crossing the middle Dnepr at Mogilev. A beachhead there will threatened the flanks of both Army Groups Center and South. You have to cross to the right bank and penetrate the socalled "Eastern wall".
Kicking in the door - April 17th, 1946
Commander, our spring offensive has begun. We need you and your men to crack the line just west of Minsk. A small German battle group will be guarding your northern flank.
The Russians have suffered horrific losses in the air over the past month so the only planes you should see overhead will be ours. Good luck Commander.

Comrade General, Comrade Stalin is seriously thinking on you as a candidate for the Commander of the Polish People's Army - at last thanks to your troops' bayonets the Polish Government in Lublin was created.
Nice job Commander. That was a tough nut to crack but you pulled it off with great skill. Now on to Minsk.

RED MENACE (Germany vs USSR)

---This is the original Red Menace campaign where USA has been replaced by Germany---

Welcome to Red Menace! This is a fictional campaign which takes place in early post war Europe. The basic premise is that international tensions regarding the division of Germany become explosive and  minor border skirmishes between German and Russian forces erupts into a full scale Soviet invasion. The campaign takes the German commander from trying to resist the initial Soviet advances to taking the initiative and forcing the Russians all way back to Red Square.

Wonderful!!!, Stalin himself is sending his congratulations to you. You are a good communist, now we have under our control all the naval bases on Norway, and we can give a pressure on the Brits from Norwegian sea.

Well, commander the battle was, shall we say, slightly difficult, and Jerry managed to cause problems for us. Britain has returned to the continent, and for this we are grateful. At least, the enemy must stretch their resources even further.
General, the fighting has been hard but London is ours!! Churchill has escaped to the North, now no one can deny the Third Reich's Victory!!
Impressive!, The British have been erased from the Portsmouth area!, and now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
This is a choice scenario. At this stage the campaign consists in two different paths and you can select which path you will follow.
If you get a BRILLAND VICTORY: You will follow the path Arnhem - Metz - The Battle of the Bulge - Dessau - The Ruhr.
If you chose this path, you will always follow this historical line whatever your results.

If you get VICTORY or a TACTICAL VICTORY: you will try to capture Hitler if he flees from Berlin in the "Alpenfestung", you will follow the path Arracourt - Gothic Line - Malmedy - Austria - Berchtesgaden.
Be aware that if you don't achieve a victory in any single scenario, you will play scenarios from the other path without any possibility to come back to this line of events.
The Russians attack the Finns at Viipuri.
A victory here will put Finland out of the war.
ROAD TO BERLIN
Road to Berlin
Campaign designer: Jorge Gabitto
PeGWW2 conversion: Robert Mary, 12/2004
The fascists are at Stalingrad.  It is time to show the Motherland that you are the one to lead Soviet troops to the final victory in Berlin.

Good morning, general, You've made quite wise decision turning to our side. The Reich appreciates your courage. You and your soldiers can now fight alongside us against communism. Although it is a hard time, we believe the Führer will find the right solution.
Well done General, we are controlling Berlin, I know that was a hard fight but you will receive a reward.
Patton hasn't choice but retreat against our glorious advance of our Soviet army.
You did it Commander! We got what we came for, and you've done a fine job for us.  And now son, it's time to go home. You've done your country proud. Here have a cigar. See you stateside.

Commander, we may be in a bit of trouble here. G2 reports that an entire Russian Armored Corp and several independant Tank Brigades are bearing down on our border positions as we speak. Bad weather has prevented the Air Corp from interdicting them. We need you back in that sector as a mobile reserve. The attack could come at any day now. Good luck.
General, that was marginal at best.
This will make our seizure of Vladivostok far more difficult.
Commander, You have broken through the enemy lines, but you took too long and Rommel retreated relatively unharmmed.

Comrade General the Zitadelle offensive has exhausted itself! The time has come to attack towards Orel and threaten the German positions from behind! You should take command and coordinate the operations.

Comrade General you have achieved some success, but your dilatory tactics have failed to clear this part of the Ukraine from Germans invaders! STAVKA is very pleased with your command of the operation!

Congratulations!  Brilliant performance.  All of Austria is now open to attack. The Third Reich is sure to fall soon. Unfortunately Soviet troops will soon occupy Vienna, we have to meet Agreements decided in Yalta.

Well sir, your performance at Metz was rather, how can I put it politely, subpar.  Many at GHQ believe that more is expected of a officer of your reputed caliber. Nevertheless, you will have a chance to redeem yourself, but I must tell you that patience all round is wearing thin.
Nethe River

Your indecisiveness showed poor coordination between combined arms, terrible usage of reconnaisance, and a very poor dispersal of units.  Your performance has left the units under your command in shambles.
I will have to send someone else who is more competent to get the job done.
General, we have a small situation here.
Ivan has scraped together quite a force on our left flank at Astrakhan.
I need you to get down there and deal with it.
We can't advance West until our flank is secure.
Playing tip: Bridging units will be necessary to win this scenario.

Commander, you have narrowly achieved your objectives.  Unfortunately, German forces have been able to withdraw in good order and regroup behind new defensive lines.  You are obviously suffering from combat stress and will be reassigned to oversee the construction of weather stations in Greenland.  Dismissed.
Comrade General: This is our opportunity to reach the lower Dnepr at Perekop  and isolate the German facists in the Crimea! You will command the operations of the Fourth Ukrainian Front!
Commander, you got the job done at Caen.  Unfortunately, we lost a lot of GIs in the process.  Well, you did your best, I know, son, and you'll be given another chance to prove yourself.

This operation was a snafu from the start, Commander.  The United States Army doesn't have the time or the patience to put up with such ineptitude.  Do me a personal favor and get outta here.  Dismissed!
With Stalingrad firmly in our hands, we've isolated the rest of Russia from
any further supplies.
The Soviets have started to ask about terms.
Very well done.
You've isolated the majority of Ivan's forces in the east and we should be
able to neutralize them shortly.
No rest for the wicked, keep moving west along the railroad.

I'm impressed, you earned your pay. Now we've got some elbow room, which means we can break out of Normandy and get to work liberating France.  Commander, we need you over in Caen.  The Krauts have really dug in there and we need someone who can kick some tail so we can get a move on.
Great Job, Moscow is now back to normal and Comrade Stalin is safe thanks to your intervention.

The Sixth and Fourth Panzer Armies start the direct assault of Stalingrad.
The Soviets defend with the entire Sixty Second Army and units of the
Sixty Fourth. A victory here will open the road to Astrakhan and the
Caucasus.

been designated Stavka representative at the Southwestern Front. You
should take charge of the operations of the Sixty Second Army.  The city
should not fall! Do not dissapoint Vassiliev!

The former Spanish Republic is come back, and the fascists leaders of that rebellion have been sent to Siberia for a long holidays.
Congratulations, commander!  You have saved our nation. I can assure you that your name shall be remembered alongside the greatest heroes of our nation.
November 9, 1942
The Soviet forces attack the flanks of the Sixth Army guarded by
Romanian troops.
The city of Kalach on the Don River is their objective.
Success will be encirclement of the Sixth Army.

Comrade General the hour of our revenge has come. We have secretely gathered powerful forces on the flanks of the German forces. Only Romanian and other weak Axis forces face us. General Zhukov has ordered you to direct the operations of the northern pincer!
Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! As we speak our pincers are joinning East of Kalach. The German Sixth Army is surrounded!
Comrade General you have achieved a great victory! The Romanian and German troops are on the run! Vassiliev is very pleased with your command of the operation!
You have exceeded our expectations!  The enemy has been crushed.  We are victorious.   Now, the Red Army holds the initiative.  This is good, very good.  To the west, Comrade!
Winter Storm (RTB#03)

Von Manstein attacks the Soviet Fifty First Army in order to open the road to the encircled Sixth Army in Stalingrad. The 17th Panzer division is on its way to support the attack while the Soviets are rushing the 2nd Guards Army to defend the Myshkova line.
General, the soviet scientists thank your care with the installations, the information harvested here will overpower the influence of communism throughout the world.
Comrade General you have failed to stop the German offensive. The German Sixth Army has escaped! Our southern front is wrecked! The Rodina is in great danger!

What the sam hill happened Commander?  Right when the war is about to end you get yourself clobbered by the Krauts. Is that the way to end a war, mister? I don't think so.  At least it's all over and we won. You're dismissed.
Comrade General you have completely destroyed the Italian Eighth Army! Our tanks are rolling on the rear of the German force at the Myshkova! Kotelnikovo is threatened! Vassiliev is very satisfied!
